Title: Generally Available: Azure Chaos Studio now supports faults for AKS clusters using managed identity authentication

Body.Content:
Azure Chaos Studio’s faults for Azure Kubernetes Service clusters now work with managed identity authentication. Previously, local authentication through the Kubernetes API server was the only supported authentication method. To enable customers with an enhanced security posture for AKS clusters to perform fault injection, the Version 2.2 AKS Chaos Mesh faults now also support managed identity authentication. Customers using Version 2.1 faults will need to enable the new capabilities and modify the relevant experiments to use the new versions. Version 2.1 faults will be unavailable in the Chaos Studio user interface on or after January 31, 2025, but remain runnable in experiments until further notice. Learn more at this link: Using Microsoft Entra authentication with Chaos Studio AKS faults. 


For more information about Azure Chaos Studio, see Azure Chaos Studio documentation.
